_doc: Read by fake_server.py on every request. rules: first rule whose kind matches and whose `contains` is a substring of what the parent wrote (chat, extract) or of the whole prompt (other kinds) gives the reply; a dict reply is sent as JSON. kinds: chat, extract, format_admin_reply, classify, summarize. fail: graph_send, telegram, openai, github_put (true/false), sheet (ok|false|500). now_utc: ISO time app/followup.py sees (null = real clock). fb_profile: what the Graph API returns for any PSID.
